# copyright work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:copyrightWork`](gmeow-copyrightWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/copyrightWork>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The work a copyright protects. Functional: one copyright relator is about one work.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) -> [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:copyrightWork`](gmeow-copyrightWork.md) from [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) to [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md), [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind the protected work to its [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) relator — the work-side player of the copyright.

### Avoid when

- Avoid binding several works to one copyright (it is functional — each work has its own [`Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) relator) and avoid using it as the work-to-copyright link, which is [`gmeow:hasCopyright`](gmeow-hasCopyright.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:copyrightWork`](gmeow-copyrightWork.md) once per [`Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) (functional) to the [`gmeow:InformationObject`](../classes/gmeow-InformationObject.md) it protects, mirroring the work's [`gmeow:hasCopyright`](gmeow-hasCopyright.md).

### Examples

- ex:reportCopyright [`gmeow:copyrightWork`](gmeow-copyrightWork.md) ex:report.
